summary: Protocol-neutral API and usecase foundation crates for messenger, mail, social, and community microservices, layered over the domain foundation slice.
claim_boundary: API/usecase foundation only; no REST handler, adapter, persistence, runtime, CI/CD, production, hyperscaler maturity, SLO attainment, compliance, or cloud-deploy readiness claim.

facets.F1_simplicity: Small protocol-neutral types and deterministic pure usecase functions; no async runtime, no provider SDKs, no I/O.
facets.F2_hyperscaler: Honest non-claim: hyperscaler grade remains pending until runtime, telemetry, SLO, rollback, CI/CD, and promotion evidence exist.
facets.F3_adversarial: Negative tests cover tenant scope/idempotency/audit context, author/principal mismatch, voter/principal mismatch, personal mail handoff refusal, no plaintext AI assist, DMARC hard reject, personal messenger disclosure denial, work social consent, Teamblind policy, duplicate vote, and moderation evidence.
facets.F5_quality: cargo test, clippy -D warnings, and cargo fmt --check pass for all touched domain/API/usecase packages.
facets.F7_security_privacy: Usecase boundaries enforce personal/work and tenant scope, idempotency, audit correlation, lawful basis, no plaintext AI assist, author binding, and audit-safe evidence references.
facets.F11_observability: Audit correlation IDs and event-type receipts are modeled for future OTel/app-layer emission; no runtime emission claim.
